confidence_notes: Medium overall. Meal and coffee anchors are the best supported: Varanasi-specific cost-of-living figures (Numbeo Nov 2025, Citycost Sep 2026, Whereandwhen 2026) broadly agree, though they are snapshots rather than July 2026 data, and rupee figures were converted at an approximate, unsourced rate. Beer rests on one Varanasi draught figure plus general Indian ranges. Cocktail and wine_glass have no Varanasi-specific price found, so they are set at roughly twice the beer anchor (wine slightly higher) using a local beer-based relationship, and assume a licensed venue serves them. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not from any accommodation search or live listings; July is monsoon low season, so rates may sit below peak levels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Meal and coffee anchors use Varanasi-specific aggregated figures, so no comparable city was needed. Beer leans on Numbeo's Varanasi draught figure cross-checked against general Indian ranges; cocktail and wine_glass use a beer-based local relationship. Accommodation anchors are benchmarked holistically against general knowledge of mid-sized North Indian pilgrimage and heritage cities.
